findings.message: Scope in says `phase3-continue-03` 'carries the ordered remaining suffix below', and that list starts with `[rework-stage]`. This ticket already seeds `rework-stage`. `tests/test_seeded_phase3_core.py` sets the convention: each continuation's carried list starts with the deliverable that continuation seeds (`phase3-continue` carries `merge-queue` first). Handing this list to `phase3-continue-03` either seeds `rework-stage` twice or leaves the suffix the same length. Section 20 requires the suffix to shrink.
findings.paved_road: State that the listed suffix is this ticket's own carried remainder, headed by the `rework-stage` it seeds. Require `phase3-continue-03`'s Scope in to carry the ordered suffix starting at `[thresh-runtime]` and ending at `[phase3-exit]`.

findings.message: No acceptance criterion requires `tests/test_seeded_phase3_02.py` to check the suffix carried in `phase3-continue-03`'s structured Scope in. Section 20 requires each continuation to carry the shrinking unseeded suffix and pin its emitted structure, so a wrong or missing suffix would pass every criterion as written.
findings.paved_road: Add a criterion: in `tests/test_seeded_phase3_02.py`, the structured YAML suffix in `tickets/phase3-continue-03/ticket.md`'s Scope in equals the exact ordered tuple from `[thresh-runtime]` through `[phase3-exit]`, parsed the way `_structured_scope_in` in `tests/test_seeded_phase3_core.py` parses it.
